title: Locality of linear circuit evaluation
statement: Let $F$ be a field with decidable equality, let $\iota$ be an input-index type, let $d\in\mathbb N$, let $R$ be a degree-$d$ resharer, and let $A$ be a finite set of parties. Suppose two party-indexed input assignments $\mathrm{inp}$ and $\mathrm{inp}'$ agree at a party $j$ on every input label. Then every syntactically linear arithmetic circuit over $F$ has the same BGW evaluation at $j$ under these two assignments.
hypotheses_covered: A is a finite set of parties
inp and inp' are party-indexed input assignments
inp and inp' agree at j for every input label
